spans.s:
चुश्च्यूषा चुश्च्यूषा, f. (fr. चूष्), sucking,
sucking out.

चुस्त चुस्त, अस्, अम्, m. n. the burnt ex-
terior of roast meat; fried meat; chaff; rind.

चूष् चूष्, cl. 1. P. चूषति, चुचूष, चू-
षिष्यति, चूषितुम्, to suck, suck out:
Pass. चूष्यते, to be sucked up or dried up (by in-
ternal inflammations &c.): Caus. चूषयति, -यितुम्,
to suck up; [cf. Lat. sugere, succus; Germ. saugen;
Iceland. siuga.]
चूषणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, capable of being sucked.

चूषा, f. a leathern girth; a girdle; sucking (?);
[cf. बूषा.]
चूषित, अस्, आ, अम्, sucked, sucked up.

चूष्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sucked, suckable; (अम्),
n. anything that can be sucked.
